# Objective

Three schema changes across the two stat subcommands, shipped as v0.6.0 and
deployed to the sibio conda channel:

1. `qc-summary` gains a `ref_len` column (BAM-header reference length).
2. All `_pct` columns rename to `_rate` — the values are already 0–1
   fractions, so the name was wrong, not the values.
3. `error-stats` gains an 8th parquet, one row per reference:
   `max_min_rate` (min depth / max depth over the reference; a zero-depth
   base makes it 0.0) and `max_error_rate` (max over positions of
   max(insertion_rate, deletion_rate, mismatch_rate)).

# Scope

- `src/sam_tagger/stats/qc_summary.py` — `ref_len` column; `_pct` → `_rate`;
  `QcSummaryCollector.__init__` takes `ref_lengths: dict[str, int]` (public
  API signature change; minor-bump territory).
- `src/sam_tagger/stats/error_stats.py` — `ErrorStatsOutputPaths.ref_summary`;
  `from_args` accepts `--ref-summary-out` (prefix or all 8 explicit paths);
  `_write_ref_summary_stats` reuses `_depth_array` (same `samtools depth -J`
  universe as `error.parquet`'s `total`).
- `src/sam_tagger/parquet_writer.py` — new `RefSummaryStats`
  (seq_name, max_min_rate, max_error_rate; Float64 rates).
- `src/sam_tagger/cli.py` — `--ref-summary-out` flag; 7-file → 8-file wording.
- `src/sam_tagger/lib.py` — pass `ref_lengths` into `QcSummaryCollector`.
- Docs: `README.md`, `docs/usage.qmd` (also repair the split error-stats
  output table).
- Tests: `test_qc_summary.py`, `test_stats.py`, `test_validation.py`.
- Version `0.5.1` → `0.6.0` in `pyproject.toml`, `pixi.toml`, `__init__.py`.
- Cross-repo: conda-recipes `recipes/sam-tagger/meta.yaml` → 0.6.0 + new
  sdist sha256; build (`pixi run build-meta sam-tagger`); publish to sibio
  (`/bioproj/data/minio` index + upload); verify via `pixi search`.

# Interpretations (stated, correct cheaply if wrong)

- `max_min_rate` min/max run over ALL reference positions, zeros included
  (literal reading of the `[3,1,4,5] → 1/5` example); an uncovered base
  therefore pins the metric at 0.0.
- `max_error_rate` per reference = max over positions and over the three
  rate kinds, value-identical to the per-position `*_rate` columns.
- No reads → both metrics 0.0 (matches the "0.0 on zero depth" convention).

# Planned steps

1. Write this plan; implement qc-summary changes + tests.
2. Implement error-stats `ref_summary` + tests; update cli/lib/writer.
3. Update README + usage.qmd; run `pixi run -e dev test`, `lint`, `typecheck`.
4. Commit per stage (feat x2, docs), then `chore(release): bump version to
   0.6.0`; annotated tag `v0.6.0`; push `main` + tag; workflow attaches
   sdist + wheel.
5. conda-recipes: meta.yaml 0.6.0 + sha256; `pixi run build-meta sam-tagger`;
   verify artifact run-deps; copy to `sibio_local/noarch/`; `pixi run index`
   + `pixi run upload` from `/bioproj/data/minio`; verify `pixi search`.
6. Report pair + requirements audit (sam-tagger primary, conda-recipes
   mirror); rolling next/recommendation sync.

# Risks

- Column renames break downstream consumers (wps_1012 uses qc-summary) —
  0.x breaking convention, called out in the release notes.
- Depth-array cost per reference is O(seq_len), already paid by
  `error.parquet`; `ref_summary` reuses the same helper, no new asymptotics.

# Verification criteria

1. `pixi run -e dev test` green; lint + typecheck clean.
2. `sam-tagger --version` → 0.6.0; tag `v0.6.0` release carries both
   artifacts.
3. `pixi search sam-tagger -c file:///bioproj/data/minio/sibio_local`
   resolves 0.6.0; repodata deps unchanged in kind.
